pages.text: $(l)Thermal Series$() (Thermal Expansion and friends) is the classic Redstone Flux tech set: dynamos make power, machines spend it, and Servos and Ducts move everything between them.$(br2)Its signature alloys come from the Induction Smelter.

$(l)Tier 4$(): signalum 35 FU, lumium 40.$(br2)$(l)Tier 5$(): enderium at 90.$(br2)Only three, because everything else Thermal makes is an ordinary furnace or crafting recipe that MC3DPrint already derives on its own. A short list means the derivation is working, not that the mod is unsupported.
